title: [Expense Agent] Send company scope header on company-bound requests
summary: Expense Agent now sends an X-ERP-Scope header on company-bound requests to route them to the correct company registration, computed from tenant ID, environment name, and company ID using UUIDv5.
key_points: Scope header added only to company-bound requests (expense submission, open report reminders, reimbursement notifications, welcome emails)
Scope ID calculated on-the-fly from AAD tenant ID, environment name, and company ID without persistence
Scope value computed as UUIDv5 hash of normalized name with fixed namespace
Company ID canonicalized to accept prefixes and various GUID formats, producing lowercase hyphenated GUID
Requests fail with error if tenant, environment, or company is missing instead of being sent without scope
